title: Everything for Life and Godliness
speaker: Pastor Billy Philips
summary: Peter's last letter opens with the best news before it names a single danger: God's divine power has already granted you everything for life and godliness. You share in His nature as a gift received and never seized, so you make every effort to grow, climbing from faith to love because grace is the reason for effort. And the ground under your feet is an eyewitness who saw Jesus shine on the mountain and a prophetic word carried by the Holy Spirit, a lamp in a dark place until the morning star rises in your heart.
subtitle: 1 and 2 Peter Week 6
